O.outcome_detail: diagnostic accuracy in emergency chest X-ray interpretation

cells.quote: The diagnostic accuracy of family medicine residents (58.0%) was not significantly different from physicians who were not enrolled in postgraduate training programs, including medical interns and general practitioners (58.0% vs. 61.4%; U = 3649; P = 0.23); however, the diagnostic accuracy of family medicine residents was significantly less than that of the diagnostic radiology residents (58.0% vs. 90.5%; U = 118; P < 0.001).
cells.note: The comparison is between nonrandomized training groups in an online survey.
